title: Underwriting Table: Lost-Income Settlement and Time Held at the HostCover Level
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) income-loss claims.** The income new-cover share follows how long the plan had held its current HostCover level when the damaged stay checked in, counted in calendar days from the plan's last level change (or from its enrollment when the level was never changed) to the date the host service fee was assessed on that stay: fewer than 90 days settles the lost income at 50 percent, 90 to 364 days at 75 percent, and 365 days or more in full. The percentage applies to the lost income being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

| From | To | Days | Lost income settled at |
|---|---|---|---|
| the plan's last level change date, or its enrollment date if the level was never changed | the date the host service fee was assessed on the damaged stay (Host Accounts) | fewer than 90 | 50 percent |
| as above | as above | 90 to 364 | 75 percent |
| as above | as above | 365 or more | in full |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical plan enrolled 2025-06-01, level never changed)

| Host service fee assessed on the damaged stay | Days | Settled at |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-08-29 | 89 | 50 percent |
| 2025-08-30 | 90 | 75 percent |
| 2026-05-31 | 364 | 75 percent |
| 2026-06-01 | 365 | in full |

If that plan's level had been changed on 2025-12-02, a stay whose host service fee was assessed on 2026-03-02 would count 90 days from the change, settled at 75 percent.
